This application coming on for admission   following:
 ORDER
Statements of the parents of the deceased are taken on record.

This second bail application is filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 in connection with Crime No.02/2022 registered at Police Station Palohabada, Distt. Narsinghpur for the offence punishable under Sections 304B, 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent.
He is falsely implicated in this case.

Earlier bail application has been dismissed by this Court as withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer after material prosecution witnesses are examined vide order dated 25/4/2022 passed in MCrC no.20360/2022.
He is in custody since 1/1/2022.
He is husband of deceased Sonam.
Statements of the parents of the deceased were recorded on 30/1/2023.
There are material contradictions in their statements.

sentences.text: There are general and omnibus allegation against the applicant.
Material prosecution witnesses have been examined.
There are no chances of tempering.
Trial will take time for its conclusion.
Hence, prayer is made to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Learned Panel Lawyer for the State, in his turn, opposes the bail application.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the material available on record, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to extend benefit of bail to the applicant.
Hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, this bail application is allowed.

I t is directed that applicant Devi Singh be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the said Court on the dates given by the concerned Court during pendency of trial.
It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE m/-
